Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Task jobs can time out before finishing 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>plan_run() uses task_job_timeout_minutes(), which budgets only 60 seconds per attempt for work
>including the workspace snapshot, although _snapshot_patch() alone can wait up to 600 seconds.
>When snapshots take longer than that allowance, the workflow can terminate a valid task job before
>it finishes, even though planning approved the suite.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[hb/plan.py[79]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/pull/6/files#diff-19782370be3ee656dae79282a5c795254c797423e8b97d1b69d832fd907b49d5R79-R79) > >```diff >+ return {"tasks": ids, "timeout_minutes": task_job_timeout_minutes(suite, max(probe_timeouts))} >``` >
>
>Relevance >
> > `●●● Strong` > >
>Concrete timeout-budget mismatch can terminate valid jobs; similar deadline handling was accepted
>recently.
>
> > [PR-#3](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/pull/3) > [PR-#1](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/pull/1) > > ⓘ Recommendations generated based on similar findings in past PRs >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>The new call makes the existing estimate the timeout supplied to the workflow. That estimate allows
>60 seconds of per-attempt overhead, while the execution path permits a 600-second snapshot on each
>successful attempt.
>
> > [hb/plan.py\[17-32\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/92f8168e2fdaedd423d942d74032f23faacd0a1a/hb/plan.py/#L17-L32) > [hb/plan.py\[74-79\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/92f8168e2fdaedd423d942d74032f23faacd0a1a/hb/plan.py/#L74-L79) > [hb/orchestrator.py\[85-92\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/92f8168e2fdaedd423d942d74032f23faacd0a1a/hb/orchestrator.py/#L85-L92) > [hb/orchestrator.py\[297-301\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/92f8168e2fdaedd423d942d74032f23faacd0a1a/hb/orchestrator.py/#L297-L301) > [hb/orchestrator.py\[339-343\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/92f8168e2fdaedd423d942d74032f23faacd0a1a/hb/orchestrator.py/#L339-L343) > [.github/workflows/bench.yml\[80-89\]](https://github.com/SigorMatt/harness-bench/blob/92f8168e2fdaedd423d942d74032f23faacd0a1a/.github/workflows/bench.yml/#L80-L89) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The newly wired planner can approve a suite with a task-job timeout shorter than the time its execution path permits. Its 60-second per-attempt overhead does not cover a workspace snapshot that can take 600 seconds. >## Fix Focus Areas >- hb/plan.py[17-32] >- hb/plan.py[74-79] >- hb/orchestrator.py[85-92] >## Recommended Fix >Include the permitted snapshot duration and other bounded per-attempt operations in the timeout calculation. Recheck the hosted-job limit using that bound, and add a test for a suite near the limit. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
